name: Kasauti Zindagii Kay
description: A re-imagination of Anurag and Prerna's soul-stirring romance. Made for each other, will these star-crossed lovers unite against the odds of betrayal, revenge, and retribution?

videos.title: Meet Anurag and Prerna
videos.overview: Set in Kolkata, meet the families of Anurag and Prerna. Amidst the Durga Puja celebrations, a shock awaits them.

videos.title: Prerna's Life Is in Danger
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose as Prerna and Anjali get caught in a blazing fire. Anurag enters the Durga Puja pandal to save them.

videos.title: Prerna Feels Uncomfortable
videos.overview: Prerna visits Anurag's house and feels uncomfortable as Naveen misbehaves with her. Later, Prerna and Anurag's family take part in the Durga puja.

videos.title: Naveen Lusts for Prerna
videos.overview: Naveen tells Mohini about his decision to marry Prerna. Anurag challenges Prerna to never fall in love.

videos.title: Mohini Visits Prerna's House
videos.overview: Rajesh and his wife are shocked as Mohini proposes to get Prerna married to Naveen. Mohini seeks revenge against Prerna's family. Why?

videos.title: Prerna Takes a Stern Decision
videos.overview: Nivedita criticises Rajesh for splurging a huge sum of money on a pandal. Prerna takes a shocking decision and conveys the same to Naveen.

videos.title: Prerna Is Adamant
videos.overview: With a heavy heart, Prerna decides to get married to Naveen. Later, Prerna and Anurag get trapped in the college library.

videos.title: Prerna to Get Engaged
videos.overview: Prerna holds back her tears and visits Mohini's house with her family to get engaged to Naveen. Anurag remains shocked after learning about the same.

videos.title: Moloy to Stop the Ceremony?
videos.overview: Naveen celebrates his engagement with Prerna until Moloy intervenes them. Moloy asks Prerna to confess. Will Prerna admit Naveen's true intentions?

videos.title: Anurag Tries to Convince Prerna
videos.overview: Anurag tries his best to change Prerna's mind about the marriage. Prerna comes across Anurag as she steps out for shopping with Naveen. Will Prerna consider Anurag's words?

videos.title: Anurag Eavesdrops on Naveen
videos.overview: Anurag feels suspicious as he eavesdrops on Naveen's conversation. Later, Prerna asks Anurag to drive faster as they get chased by a car.

videos.title: Naveen Meets a Lady
videos.overview: A popular actress visits the same theatre as Anurag and Prerna. Later, Anurag feels suspicious as he spots Naveen meeting a lady.

videos.title: Prerna, Anurag Help Friends
videos.overview: Prerna and Anurag figure out how to effectively evade Kirti's parents. Kirti and Rohan thank Prerna and Anurag for helping them get hitched. Mohini is concerned about Anurag.

videos.title: Anurag, Prerna Serve Jail Time
videos.overview: Kirti's parents allege Prerna and Anurag to have kidnapped Kirti and lodge a police complaint. The police confront Anurag and Prerna before arresting them.

videos.title: Mohini's Stand Against Prerna
videos.overview: Mohini blames Prerna for Anurag's arrest and reveals her shocking decision to Naveen. Anurag compels Prerna to share her problems with him.

videos.title: Anurag, Prerna Get Released
videos.overview: Naveen comes up with a plan to resolve the situation and gets Anurag and Prerna released by seeking Chaubey Ji's help. However, he has something up his sleeve.

videos.title: Anurag Comforts Prerna
videos.overview: Anurag visits Prerna's house to invite her family for the engagement. Later, he consoles a distressed Prerna.

videos.title: Anurag to Expose Naveen
videos.overview: Naveen feels jealous as he sees Anurag help Prerna get ready. Later, Anurag plans to expose Naveen's secret affair before everyone. How?

videos.title: A Bride for Anurag?
videos.overview: Naveen fears that Anurag might expose his illicit relationship. He tells Mohini about a prospective bride for Anurag. Mohini tells him to invite her home.

videos.title: Anurag, Prerna Feel Special
videos.overview: Anurag and Prerna feel special after spending time with each other. Later, an annoyed Anurag decides to stop Naveen from marrying Prerna.

videos.title: Anurag Corners Naveen
videos.overview: Anurag decides to expose Naveen's illicit affair and asks his parents to arrive at the hotel immediately. Later, Anurag barges inside Naveen's hotel room. Will Naveen get caught?

videos.title: Naveen Outsmarts Anurag
videos.overview: Anurag tries to expose Naveen's true colours. However, Naveen outsmarts him and portrays him in the bad light. Later, the engagement ceremony begins.

videos.title: Prerna Faces an Odd Situation
videos.overview: Mohini gets irritated when Prerna wears an ordinary sari to the engagement ceremony. Later, something unexpected happens when Prerna visits Anurag's room before the ring ceremony.

videos.title: Anurag and Prerna's Intimacy
videos.overview: Prerna seeks Anurag's help to remove the engagement ring from her finger. Later, they get intimate and experience love.

videos.title: Naveen Tries to Get Rid of Ronita
Anurag, Prerna Perform a Ritual
videos.overview: Naveen hurts himself while trying to hide from Anurag. Later, Prerna accidentally performs an auspicious ritual with Anurag instead of Naveen!

videos.title: Naveen One-ups Anurag
videos.overview: Anurag regains consciousness and looks for Prerna. However, not all is fine for the two.

videos.title: Naveen Challenges Anurag
videos.overview: Naveen's unrepentant behaviour drives Anurag to do something outrageous. Things heat up when Naveen challenges Anurag.

videos.title: Will Prerna Believe Anurag?
videos.overview: Anurag leaves no stones unturned to convince Prerna to call-off the wedding. But, will she give in to her doubts?

videos.title: Anurag's Unexpected Move
videos.overview: With just a few minutes away from the wedding, when Prerna refuses to cooperate, Anurag takes a shocking step!

videos.title: Naveen's Marriage Has a Twist
videos.overview: Prerna and Naveen perform their marriage rituals while Anurag is shattered over his inability to stop the wedding. However, Naveen is in for a rude shock.

videos.title: Madhuri Unveils the Truth
videos.overview: While Prerna finds herself locked in a room, Madhuri reveals a shocking truth about Naveen.

videos.title: Anurag Presents the Proof
videos.overview: Naveen plans to escape from the wedding venue with an ignorant Prerna. Meanwhile, Anurag presents more evidence against Naveen.

videos.title: Naveen Loses His Mind
videos.overview: Anurag discloses Prerna's side of the story. Later, in an attempt to escape, Naveen crosses all limits.

videos.title: Prerna-Anurag Finally Relieved?
videos.overview: Moloy extends a kind gesture towards Prerna. Nivedita instigates Mohini against Prerna, while Prerna and Anurag are lost in each other's thoughts.

videos.title: Prerna's First Day in Office
videos.overview: Prerna begins her first day at the office. Later, the situation worsens when she engages in a heated argument with Anurag.

videos.title: Is Mishka Back in Anurag's Life?
Anurag, Prerna Are Stuck in a Riot
Prerna, Mr. Bajaj to Tie the Knot
Prerna Takes Care of Mr Bajaj
Mr Bajaj Is in a Tough Spot
Komolika's Horrific Plan
videos.overview: Anurag rushes Prerna to the hospital while Veena is shattered on learning about the accident. Later, Komolika hatches a plan to kill Prerna's unborn child.

videos.title: Anurag Finds a Groom for Prerna?
Anurag Fails to Save His Child?
Prerna Is in for a Surprise
Prerna Saves Anurag
videos.overview: Prerna recalls the disastrous accident after racing against time to get Anurag hospitalised. On the other hand, the Basus are in turmoil over his life.

videos.title: Komolika Is Fuming Mad
videos.overview: Prerna and Komolika engage in mind games while Anurag asks about the former upon regaining consciousness. At the hospital, Sohini slaps an enraged Komolika.

videos.title: Mr Bajaj Suspects Prerna?
videos.overview: Kukki's statements get her in trouble at college while Mr Bajaj suspects Prerna's intentions after Komolika's call. Later, Prerna visits her family with Kukki.

videos.title: What Is Anurag Upto?
videos.overview: Anurag secretly meets his friend, Sudeep for a favour while Mohini and Nivedita are at loggerheads. Later, Anurag saves a young girl from getting into an accident.

videos.title: Prerna Achieves Her Goal
videos.overview: Anurag and Prerna get into a heated exchange at a coffee shop. While Kaushik wants to exact revenge against Kukki, Prerna celebrates her victory.

videos.title: A Shocker for Komolika
videos.overview: Mr Bajaj personally meets Komolika to warn her. Baffled by the sight of an intoxicated Anurag, Komolika later gets some bad news.

videos.title: Prerna Invites Komolika
videos.overview: Prerna invites a furious Komolika for the inauguration party. Later, Komolika puts forth a request to Anurag while he is in a dilemma.

videos.title: Nivedita Strikes a Plan
videos.overview: While Prerna waits for Anurag, Veena back answers Mohini at the party. Meantime, Nivedita hatches an ingenious plan to seek revenge against Komolika.

videos.title: Mohini, Nivedita Join Hands
videos.overview: Mohini decides to help Nivedita get close to Mr. Bajaj while Kaushik and Anushka shake a leg. Later, a heated argument erupts in between Prerna and Komolika.

videos.title: Mr. Bajaj Justifies Himself
videos.overview: Komolika observes something strange in Prerna's room. Meanwhile, Mr. Bajaj justifies his actions to Prerna. Later, Nivedita starts a conversation with Mr. Bajaj.

videos.title: Komolika's Vicious Ploy
videos.overview: Prerna threatens Komolika while the latter brews a vicious plan to seek vengeance in return. Later, Prerna is at a loss for words when Shivani gets abducted.

videos.title: Mr Bajaj Is in Trouble?
videos.overview: Prerna gets into a war of words with Nivedita and Mohini while Komolika acts innocent. Later, Mr Bajaj's conversation with the police gets secretly recorded.

videos.title: Shivani's Unexpected Revelation
videos.overview: While the police arrest Komolika and Ronit, Shivani makes a shocking revelation to the press reporters. Elsewhere, the Basus learn a startling news from Prerna.

videos.title: Prerna Questions Shivani
videos.overview: Prerna confronts Shivani about Ronit and in turn learns about their relationship. Meanwhile, Komolika plans to announce Ronit and Shivani's engagement.

videos.title: Komolika's New Team
videos.overview: Prerna tries to bridge the gap between Shivani and her while Mr Bajaj learns a shocking truth. Elsewhere, Mohini and Nivedita join hands with Komolika.

videos.title: Prerna's Worst Nightmare
videos.overview: Moloy and Kaushik set out to find the truth behind Ronit and Shivani's relationship. Later, Prerna is forced to accept Shivani getting engaged to Ronit.

videos.title: Mr Bajaj's Caring Gesture
videos.overview: Moloy remains suspicious of Komolika and Ronit while Mr Bajaj gives Shivani a sweet surprise for her engagement. Later, Mohini and Nivedita scheme up a new plan.

videos.title: Komolika Creates a Fuss
videos.overview: As the guests arrive for Shivani and Ronit's engagement, Komolika causes a ruckus. Later, Prerna fears Mr Bajaj has misunderstood her about Anurag.

videos.title: Prerna Misses Sneha
videos.overview: Prerna is overwhelmed with emotions as she mourns Sneha's tragic demise. Later, she meets Samidha and engages in a heartfelt conversation.

videos.title: Mr Bajaj Suspects Komolika
videos.overview: Mr Bajaj grows suspicious of Komolika and tries to uncover her true motive. Later, Komolika instructs her mother to initiate the next step of her plan.

videos.title: Mr Bajaj Makes a Declaration
videos.overview: Mohini interrupts the ceremony and begins to insults Veena for not following traditions. Later, an enraged confronts Mr Bajaj for his abrupt announcement.

videos.title: Prerna Is Sorry
videos.overview: After the ring exchange ceremony, Prerna apologises to Mr. Bajaj for her behaviour. While he warns Komolika, disaster strikes the function.

videos.title: Prerna Risks Her Life
videos.overview: Prerna puts her life in danger and enters the burning house to save Samidha. While Komolika expresses her anger, Mr Bajaj runs in after Prerna.

videos.title: Prerna Gets Emotional
videos.overview: Prerna takes care of Samidha after learning about her illness. While Kaushik has conflicting feelings for Kukki, Mr Bajaj tries to console an emotional Prerna.

videos.title: Mr. Bajaj Makes an Observation
videos.overview: Mr. Bajaj tells Prerna that she could be a great mother to Samidha. Later, Komolika arrives at their residence and notices Prerna's immense fondness for Samidha.

videos.title: Anurag Returns Home!
videos.overview: During Ronit and Shivani's wedding preparations, the Basus are overwhelmed by Anurag's unexpected return. Later, an infuriated Anurag confronts Shivani.

videos.title: Anurag Threatens Ronit
videos.overview: Prerna asks Anurag to leave the house after he degrades Shivani and her. While Komolika acts innocent, Anurag threatens Ronit with dire consequences.

videos.title: Komolika Finds Prerna's Weakness
videos.overview: Upon unraveling some startling details, Komolika deduces Samidha is Prerna's biggest weakness. Elsewhere, Kukki gets accused of leaking the question papers.

videos.title: Kukki Gets Rusticated?
videos.overview: Komolika uncovers a secret about Anurag while Kaushik feels guilty seeing Kukki break down. Later, Anurag has the final say in Kukki's rustication from college.

videos.title: Anurag Stands by Kukki
videos.overview: After learning that the student facing rustication is Kukki, Anurag approaches the principal and vouches for her. Later, Anurag pours his heart out to his father.

videos.title: Anurag Apologises to Kukki
videos.overview: The Basus and the Bajaj's come together for Ronit and Shivani's Sangeet ceremony. Later, Anurag apologises to Kukki for signing the rustication form.

videos.title: Moloy Slaps Anurag
videos.overview: After learning about Anurag's attempt to kill Prerna, an infuriated Moloy slaps him. However, Anurag defends his actions and tries to pacify Moloy.

videos.title: Anurag Misses Sneha
videos.overview: Anurag misses Sneha when he notices Samidha spending quality time with Prerna. Later, he assures Samidha that she will reunite with her parents.

videos.title: A Truce Between Anurag, Prerna?
videos.overview: Anurag gets possessive when Prerna and Mr. Bajaj shake a leg together. While Anurag and Prerna dance along with Samidha, Shivani loses her engagement ring.

videos.title: Anurag's Shocking Confession
videos.overview: Anurag confesses to Komolika that he is still madly in love with Prerna. Later, Komolika devises a plan to bring Prerna and Mr. Bajaj closer.

videos.title: Prerna, Anurag are Caught?
videos.overview: While Shivani and Ronit share a dance together, Komolika slaps Nivedita for her foolish act. Later, Anurag and Prerna are caught embracing by Komolika.

videos.title: Anurag Blurts the Truth Out
videos.overview: Komolika vents out her frustration on Prerna for embracing Anurag. Later, Anurag lashes out at her for forcing him to destroy Prerna's life.

videos.title: Anurag Helps Samidha
videos.overview: While Anurag gives a stern warning to Komolika, Kukki's unexpected disappearance worries Prerna. Later, he takes care of an injured Samidha.

videos.title: A Stunner for Prerna
videos.overview: Samidha admires Anurag and Prerna argue against one another. While Prerna is for a shock of her life, Komolika tricks Anurag and obtains his signature on some documents.

videos.title: Prerna, Samidha's Pact
videos.overview: While Samidha and Prerna make a pact that helps each other, Komolika executes her diabolical plan. Later, Prerna and Samidha fall in grave danger.

videos.title: Komolika Challenges Prerna
videos.overview: Komolika informs Rohitash that Anurag has given the nod for the demolition of the orphanage. While Prerna tries to confront Anurag, Komolika challenges her.

videos.title: Komolika Threatens Nivedita
videos.overview: While Samidha consoles a dejected Prerna, Komolika's heartless act leaves Nivedita disappointed. Later, Komolika threatens Nivedita.

videos.title: Samidha Surprises Prerna
videos.overview: While both the families come together for Ronit and Shivani's mehndi ceremony, Samidha surprises Prerna. On the other hand, Anurag gets a blast from the past.

videos.title: Are Anurag, Prerna Friends?
videos.overview: Samidha stops Prerna and Anurag from snapping at each other, asking them to become friends. Meanwhile, Veena and Mohini bicker at the function.

videos.title: Anurag Helps Prerna
videos.overview: While Kukki learns about Kaushik's feelings for her, Moloy attempts to uncover Komolika's intentions. Elsewhere, Anurag offers to help Prerna when she is wounded.

videos.title: Anurag Apologises to Prerna
videos.overview: Prerna criticises Anurag for pretending to care about her. However, he pours his heart out to her and apologises for his wrongdoings.

videos.title: Prernas Bitter Memories
videos.overview: Kukki is irked when Anushka flirts with Kaushik while Anurag and Prerna engage in a tiff. Trapped together in a room, Prerna vents her frustrations on Anurag.

videos.title: Komolika's Shocking Outburst
videos.overview: Anurag's concern leaves Prerna startled while Komolika slaps Ronit for committing a blunder. When Prerna falls unconscious, Anurag gets baffled.

videos.title: Anurag's Emotional Outburst
videos.overview: Anurag grows emotional upon seeing Prerna's condition while Komolika confronts him. After regaining consciousness, Prerna learns a shocking truth.

videos.title: Komolika Plays Her Trump Card
videos.overview: While Komolika puts forth an ultimatum before Prerna, Anurag notices Samidha in tears and helps her. Later, Komolika and Anurag get into a heated exchange.

videos.title: Anurag Confesses the Truth?
videos.overview: While Samidha takes care of Prerna, Mr. Bajaj vents his frustration out on finding an unacceptable mistake. Later, Anurag contemplates telling Prerna the truth.

videos.title: Prerna Stuns Komolika
videos.overview: Prerna sees her photograph on a leading magazine cover while Komolika tries to seduce Anurag. Later, Komolika is startled as Prerna agrees to sign on the papers.

videos.title: Prerna Threatens Komolika
videos.overview: After striking the deal, Prerna threatens Komolika for ensuring the safety of the orphanage. On the other hand, Anurag and Mr. Bajaj get into a heated argument.

videos.title: Komolika Enjoys Her Victory
videos.overview: Anurag is in a state of panic when the brakes of his car fail while Priyanka's sister makes a startling discovery. Later, Komolika revels in her success.

videos.title: Kaushik Confesses the Truth?
videos.overview: After a talk with Nivedita, Kaushik decides to tell Kukki the truth. While Prerna makes a startling discovery, Anurag suspects Nivedita and Komolika.

videos.title: Kaushik, Kukki in Trouble?
videos.overview: Prerna and Samidha enjoy their time together. While Mr. Bajaj notices Kaushik and Kukki together, Komolika is thrilled upon getting some vital information.

videos.title: Anurag Is Upto Something
videos.overview: Kaushik decides to break into the college with some help to clear Kukki's name. Later, Anurag's family is stunned when he shows love and care towards Komolika.

videos.title: A Shocker for Komolika
videos.overview: Komolika is baffled after learning that Sneha is alive while Kukki decides to share her feelings for Kaushik with Prerna. Meanwhile, Anurag confronts Nivedita.

videos.title: Kaushik Is Caught Red-handed
videos.overview: Kukki confesses to Prerna about her feelings for Kaushik. While Nivedita receives Anupam's phone call, Kaushik lands in severe trouble in his college.

videos.title: Anurag Slaps Kaushik
videos.overview: The Basus and the Bajajs are shocked to learn about Kaushik's daring act to prove Kukki's innocence. Later, Anurag slaps Kaushik in the principal's cabin.

videos.title: Prerna's Unexpected Revelation
videos.overview: Anurag stands in support of Kukki and appeals for Kaushik's rustication. Later, he is baffled when Prerna tells him about Kaushik and Kukki being madly in love.

videos.title: Komolika Spills the Beans
videos.overview: After being confronted by Anurag, Komolika spills the beans about Bajaj City project. On the other hand, Mr. Bajaj learns about the reason behind Prerna's actions.

videos.title: Anupam Is Back?
videos.overview: Nivedita and Mohini are left dumbstruck by Anupam's entry. While Kaushik expresses his feelings to Kukki, Komolika gets enraged by Mr. Bajaj's smart move.

videos.title: Prerna's Ingenious Plan
videos.overview: Prerna informs Anurag about the money he owes because of Mr. Bajaj's sneaky plan. Elsewhere, Priyanka learns about Komolika's secret.

videos.title: Prerna Learns the Truth?
videos.overview: Prerna feels overjoyed about Priyanka's suggestion, while Komolika plans to adopt Samidha. Later, Kaushik confesses his love to Kukki.

videos.title: Kukki Falls Unconscious
videos.overview: Kaushik gets Kukki admitted to the hospital when she falls unconscious. Later, the doctor reveals some disturbing news about Kukki's health condition.

videos.title: Anurag Regrets His Actions
videos.overview: While Anurag apologises to Prerna for letting her suffer alone, Kaushik is left hurt by Kukki's lie. Later, Prerna is dumbstruck upon learning a shocking fact.

videos.title: Prerna's Unbridled Rage
videos.overview: Prerna threatens to cut Chandrika's finger if she doesn't reveal the truth. Meanwhile, Shivani and Anushka advise Kukki, Mohini and Nivedita get some shocking news.

videos.title: Anurag Becomes Emotional
videos.overview: Anurag gets emotinal with Samidha after Prerna tells him the truth while Kukki confesses her love to Kaushik. Later, Komolika plans to do the unthinkable.

videos.title: Anurag Pours His Heart Out?
videos.overview: Anurag sets off to save Prerna after leaning about Komolika's plan. While Mohini overhears a shocking detail, Anurag decides to confess the truth to Prerna.

videos.title: Anurag to Convince Prerna?
videos.overview: An emotional Anurag presents Prerna with evidence of Komolika's devious act. Later, he gets injured while fighting the goons at the temple.

videos.title: A Happy Ending for Anurag, Prerna
videos.overview: Anurag and Prerna reunite at the temple while a major disaster strikes at the Basu mansion. Nonetheless, all ends well for Anurag and Prerna!
